question: What consequence follows from a guru initiating a disciple out of pride?
premises: A guru should not initiate a disciple.
A guru endowed with truth should not act from pride.
One who does so would dwell in hell.
One who does so would become diseased here.
inference: Initiation motivated by pride brings hellish dwelling and present disease.
uncertainties: The exact referent of "whose" is not fully explicit in the supplied gloss.
The precise scope of "tattvayuktastu" within the clause is ambiguous.
plain_english: A guru endowed with truth should not initiate a disciple out of pride; one who does so would dwell in hell and become diseased in this life.
